decisions.reason: Submitting the project to an external verification page does not change the approved About-page content.
The false-positive report and developer verification request do not revise any FAQ copy, including the existing scam explanation.
Project trust verification does not alter fiat buyers' wallet, dashboard, commission, ticket, or prize-access behavior.
The external project-verification submission does not change background wallet provisioning or custody requirements.
The trust-warning remediation request does not change the Transak provider, payment methods, conversion, or mint flow.
Submitting an external trust-verification form does not revise the Mission-page content.
The referenced developer project verification concerns false trust flags, not NFT ownership verification or Lit Protocol ebook gating.
The source decision does not alter mobile-wallet signing or ebook-access behavior.
Project trust verification does not change prize collection, claim-button visibility, announcement channels, or payment destination.
The trust-warning remediation has no effect on secondary-sale royalties or their enforcement mechanism.
The external verification submission does not change ETH payment, swap, mint, or refund semantics.
The trust-warning remediation request does not change the USDC wallet mint flow or expected mint outcome.
